global_rules: freeze run, model, dataset, evaluator and resource identities before substantive outcome access
do not inspect gold/fixed solutions from solver arms
do not redesign endpoints after outcomes except under a new run identity for documented infrastructure defects
retain parent wins, simple-control wins, negative results, invalid tasks and timeouts
automatic manuscript editing from experimental outputs is forbidden

tasks.title: preflight and exact execution identity
tasks.done_when: all local validation is green or defects are recorded under a new run identity

tasks.title: bind automated experimental arms
external_requirements: model/provider executables or interactive AI sessions
tasks.done_when: SIMPLE_DIRECT, SAME_MODEL_REFLECTION, F0 and F2_FULL are bound; missing secondary arms explicitly CANNOT_CHECK

tasks.title: T1 three-task BugsInPy execution pilot
tasks.done_when: pilot infrastructure and native evaluator operate end to end

tasks.title: T2 40-task eight-project BugsInPy confirmatory run
tasks.done_when: minimum 40 valid paired tasks and required stochastic repetitions are frozen or shortfall is reported as underpowered

tasks.title: T3a CausalBench cross-domain execution
tasks.done_when: F0 and F2 share native causal algorithms/data and held-out/permuted variants are independently scored

tasks.title: T3b Matbench Discovery cross-domain execution
tasks.done_when: resource/uncertainty/domain-shift decision variants are scored under matched native models

tasks.title: component ablation and drag analysis
tasks.done_when: each component is classified NECESSARY, PARENT_REPLACEABLE, CONTEXTUAL, REDUNDANT_DRAG, HARMFUL or CANNOT_CHECK

tasks.title: anti-memorization and counterfactual controls
tasks.done_when: active-solving evidence is reported without claiming proof of training-data absence

tasks.title: P-A hidden remote-parent benchmark
tasks.done_when: remote-parent recall and false-analogy/native-fidelity jointly improve or the paper contracts

tasks.title: P-B formal relation result and two naturalistic cases
tasks.done_when: a nontrivial theorem/obstruction plus two decision-changing naturalistic cases are frozen or the paper contracts

tasks.title: P-D blinded dependence/evaluator study
tasks.done_when: false corroboration/authority gains preserve genuine independent support and beat F0

tasks.title: P-E prospective opportunity cohort
external_requirements: genuine prospective or valid time-sliced cohort
tasks.done_when: incremental future value over P-C/F0 is established; otherwise merge into P-C

tasks.title: P-F predeclared machine-native mechanism experiment
tasks.done_when: matched-compute causal gain with witness sufficiency and second-domain transfer survives

tasks.title: V1-V2 parity execution
external_requirements: PARITY-C/D independent semantic reviewer custody under issue #8
tasks.done_when: frozen parity campaigns execute without critical V1 capability regression

tasks.title: claim-state update and R3 paper freeze
tasks.done_when: claim proposals are evidence-bound, manuscripts remain unedited automatically, and R3 candidates are identified

tasks.title: external field demarcation and hostile editorial review
tasks.done_when: external reviewers return reproducible field/integration/domain-federation dispositions
